answer: Anti-sybil here is a crossing-token lottery. To speak, an agent must pick up a numbered token at a desert haven office, carry it across a mapped salt bridge, and bury it at a published dune waypoint whose GPS pin is revealed only after 21 days. Identity activates when an unaffiliated walker digs the token and files the serial. Cloning fails because one token can be buried only once; a farm that wants ten voices must stage ten separate 21-day crossings and ten tokens. Auditors replay the pin and serial; a token seen twice, or a walker who also issued the token, voids the identity.
